verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents an official Python package for writing scripts that control and extend it (iterm2-docs-13, iterm2-gh-15), with hooks into triggers and status-bar components (iterm2-gh-2, iterm2-gh-12). It also offers documented AppleScript support (iterm2-docs-14), and a community user independently confirms the Python API 'lets you touch pretty much everything' (iterm2-comm-5). missing for 10: detailed evidence of API reference coverage (which objects and events are exposed), and AI-agent-friendly machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs returned 404).
